title: Functorial embedding of a tower into a split tower with split cokernel
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Call an inverse system $(X_n,g_n:X_{n+1}\to X_n)_{n\geq1}$ in $\mathcal A$ [def-weil-inverse-system] *split* if every $g_n$ has a right inverse, i.e. there are $\sigma_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ with $g_n\circ\sigma_n=\mathrm{id}_{X_n}$. For an inverse system $T=(T_n,f_n)$ write $f_{m,n}=f_n\circ f_{n+1}\circ\cdots\circ f_{m-1}:T_m\to T_n$ for $m\geq n$ ($f_{n,n}=\mathrm{id}$), and let $E(T)$ be the inverse system with $E(T)_m=\prod_{n=1}^mT_n$ (a finite product) and transition maps $E(T)_{m+1}\to E(T)_m$ the projections forgetting the factor $T_{m+1}$; for a morphism $\varphi=(\varphi_n):T\to T'$ let $E(\varphi)_m=\prod_{n\le m}\varphi_n$. Let $j_T:T\to E(T)$ have components $j_{T,m}=(f_{m,n})_{n\le m}:T_m\to\prod_{n\le m}T_n$. Then $E$ is an additive functor from inverse systems in $\mathcal A$ to inverse systems in $\mathcal A$ (i.e. a functor with $E(\varphi+\psi)=E(\varphi)+E(\psi)$, morphisms of inverse systems being added levelwise), $j_T$ is a morphism of inverse systems natural in $T$ (i.e. $E(\varphi)\circ j_T=j_{T'}\circ\varphi$), every $j_{T,m}$ is a monomorphism, and both $E(T)$ and the levelwise cokernel $C(T)=(\operatorname{coker}j_{T,m})_m$, with its induced transition maps, are split inverse systems.

proof.text: Construct E(T) at index n as the finite product over Fin (n+1), with transition Pi.lift of the castSucc projections, using Mathlib Functor.ofOpSequence. Define E(phi) with NatTrans.ofOpSequence and componentwise Pi.map. Product extensionality proves transition compatibility and the identity and composition laws. Define j using Pi.lift of the original tower maps. Functor.map_comp proves it is a tower morphism, and NatTrans.naturality proves naturality in T. The termwise isomorphisms e are Iso.refl.

proof.text: For any split mono f:X→Y with retraction r, put p=id_Y-rf (Lean composition r ≫ f). Then fp=0, so p descends along the cokernel projection q to a map d:coker(f)→Y. The identity qd=p and pq=q imply dq=id by epimorphic cancellation of q. Thus q is split epi. Evaluation preserves cokernels in the tower category, so PreservesCokernel.iso transports this splitting to each component of the tower cokernel projection.

proof.text: Write q:E(T)→coker(j_T), let b:E(T)_(n+1)→E(T)_n be the envelope transition and c the induced cokernel transition. Choose the known sections t of q_n and s of b. The morphism t ≫ s ≫ q_(n+1) is a section of c: naturality gives q_(n+1) ≫ c=b ≫ q_n, hence (t ≫ s ≫ q_(n+1)) ≫ c=t ≫ s ≫ b ≫ q_n=t ≫ q_n=id. This proves the final assertion without identifying the cokernel with an earlier-factor product.

lean.statement: theorem tower_split_envelope {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] : ∃ (E : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) ⥤ (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C)) (j : 𝟭 (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) ⟶ E) (e : ∀ (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (n : ℕ), (E.obj T).obj (Opposite.op n) ≅ ∏ᶜ fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ T.obj (Opposite.op k.val)), (∀ (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)), (E.obj T).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫ (e T n).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ T.obj (Opposite.op k.val)) k = (e T (n + 1)).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun k : Fin (n + 1 + 1) ↦ T.obj (Opposite.op k.val)) k.castSucc) ∧ (∀ (T T' : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (φ : T ⟶ T') (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)), (E.map φ).app (Opposite.op n) ≫ (e T' n).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ T'.obj (Opposite.op k.val)) k = (e T n).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ T.obj (Opposite.op k.val)) k ≫ φ.app (Opposite.op k.val)) ∧ (∀ (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)), (j.app T).app (Opposite.op n) ≫ (e T n).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ T.obj (Opposite.op k.val)) k = T.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_of_lt_succ k.isLt)).op) ∧ (∀ (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (n : ℕ), IsSplitEpi ((E.obj T).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) ∧ (∀ (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (n : ℕ), Mono ((j.app T).app (Opposite.op n))) ∧ (∀ (T T' : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (φ ψ : T ⟶ T'), E.map (φ + ψ) = E.map φ + E.map ψ) ∧ (∀ (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (n : ℕ), IsSplitEpi ((cokernel (j.app T)).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
